headline: City vs Sunderland: still 4-0-0, still a game in hand. Not kicked.
whyCareReason: Arsenal lost at Brighton. City are the last unbeaten 4-0-0 side and host Sunderland on Sunday. ESPN lists the match as not started. Do not invent a score.
teaser: Sunday, Etihad. City 12 points from four. Sunderland 4 from four. Kick-off listed, result not printed.
story:
Why this one matters: Saturday took Arsenal off the perfect start. City still have 12 points from four games and a home date with Sunderland.

Xinhua, 19 September: Man City 4 4 0 0, 8 2, 12. Sunderland 4 1 1 2, 3 5, 4. ESPN's 20 September scoreboard still lists the fixture as vs. Mundo Deportivo timed it 15:00 CEST.

Do not print a Sunday score. The game has not been played.
stakes: A chance for City to go three points clear if they win, and only if they win. The points are not in the book.
rivalryAngle: A 4-0-0 champion-elect against a promoted side. The table is the story until the whistle.
